admissionPolicy.note: A semantic rule does not require a sleep state. It may encode a validated behavior-preserving hotpath, prefilter, state cache, or multi-rate split when the current source proves the same semantic shape. Rules fail closed when that proof is incomplete.

policy.semanticIdentityPolicy: Mod/folder identity is a hint. Version-decorated names may match directly. Name-independent source identity is opt-in per rule and requires at least four independent proof points plus a source-shaped anchor; ambiguous or weak fingerprints fail closed.
policy.semanticSatisfactionPolicy: G-CET markers are authoritative when present, but equivalent manual/foreign implementations may also satisfy a semantic rule when its explicit source postconditions are all proven in the current live owner tree.
